format: rules: [{id, kind, label (Russian button text), when: {condition: value} (all must hold), offer: the mock tool that finds the priced offer, reason: Russian template with {placeholders} filled by code from computed facts and the offer}]. kind is one of what the mock sells (AGENT_PLAN Foundation decision 8): transfer, early_checkin, room_upgrade (incl. high floor), meal_upgrade, flexible_fare. No placeholders: a candidate without a priced offer is dropped. Conditions: arrival_after (HH:MM local arrival at the destination is at or after), arrival_before_checkin_min (minutes between arrival at the hotel and regular check-in >= value), children (brief has children), variant_has_transfer (variant already has a transfer step), traits_any (brief traits intersect), mood_any (brief mood intersects), prefs (brief prefs equal these values). At most rules.json max_upsell candidates reach a reply. rules_pending: rules of kinds room_upgrade, meal_upgrade, flexible_fare, kept outside `rules` only because agent/skill_loader.py UPSELL_KINDS does not list these kinds yet (contract question); move them into `rules` when the loader accepts them.
